name: word_insert_text
description: Insert text beside words found once, or at a range or position, in the formatting there. Returns the new ranges' ids.

find.description: Text occurring once, to insert beside.

target.description: Or a range, position (p:A@5) or paragraph.

at.description: Or after:/before: a range, or a position.

within.description: Block or span to search for find.
